title: Odin install step extracts the same tarball twice
detail: Two identical tar -xzf commands run back-to-back into the same destination. Idempotent and harmless, but uncommented — reads like a leftover copy-paste or a botched nested-archive extraction.
recommended_fix: Delete the duplicate line. If a nested archive was intended, extract the inner tarball by name instead of re-running the outer extraction.

title: CI 'Golden harness' step claims a replay gate but never runs replay
evidence:
- name: Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)
        run: |
          tools/harness.sh run || {

# (from tools/harness.sh)
# Usage: tools/harness.sh run [demo...] | save [demo...] | replay <demo> <log>
detail: The step name advertises a replay gate, but its body only calls `tools/harness.sh run`. harness.sh exposes `run` and `replay` as distinct verbs, so ODN-11 replay is never exercised in CI.
recommended_fix: Add a `tools/harness.sh replay <demo> <log>` step per demo (or fold a log round-trip check into `harness run`), else drop 'replay gate' from the name.

evidence:

The harness injects pre-resolved `pp.Command`s through `bus_submit`
detail: README states demos play through 'the real Input → Command_Bus → core path', but the verification-gap review in this same diff says the harness injects pre-resolved commands at the bus, exercising no Input.

title: node_types comment claims growth spawns routers; growth_roles spawns only residential
evidence:
"_comment": "... The run starts with a MID router; map growth spawns BASIC routers.",

# (from data/balance.json)
  "growth_roles": [
    "residential",
    "residential",
detail: The node_types comment attributes router spawns to 'map growth', but balance.json's growth_roles lists only 'residential' terminals; routers actually arrive via the grants block, not the growth spawner.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to 'grants add BASIC routers; growth spawns residential terminals' so the catalog's two distinct mechanisms are not conflated.

title: lint gate 2 regex misses Odin `:=` file-scope variables
evidence:
echo "-- gate 2: no file-scope var in core/"
HITS=$(grep -rnE '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*[ ]*:[ ]' core/*.odin | grep -v '_test\.odin' | grep -v '::' || true)
detail: The regex requires a space after the colon (`[ ]*:[ ]`), so Odin's inferred-type `foo := 5` file-scope declaration (colon followed by `=`) is not matched and bypasses the no-globals gate.
recommended_fix: Extend the pattern to also match `:=` (e.g. `^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*[ ]*:[ =]`), or add a second grep for `:=` file-scope declarations.
